name: Deleitosa (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, yellow and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Deleitosa (a chequy field and a castle).
history: The arms and the local flag of Deleitosa were approved by the Order of 30 December 1987 of the Consejería de la Presidencia y Trabajo published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 7 January 1988, after the municipal council's approval on 29 August 1987.
